text: I've been here many times, and the staff are very rude, as if they're unwilling to welcome customers. But it's not all of them, though. We were very polite when paying and explained our situation, but it was as if they didn't want to listen. They even suggested we go home and sleep. You work in customer service; we respect you, so please respect us in return.

restaurant_name: บางละมุงการแพทย์ คลินิกเวชกรรม
text: I had a bladder infection and received treatment here. The service was excellent. The two doctor's assistants were friendly and polite. I didn't have to wait long for the doctor. The doctor asked detailed questions, gave good advice, spoke kindly, and gave very gentle injections.

restaurant_name: บางละมุงการแพทย์ คลินิกเวชกรรม
text: The staff were rude. I came for a health checkup. I called and was told the checkup would cost 2,000 baht. When I arrived, I had to pay separately for each disease. How am I supposed to know what diseases I have? And I wanted to be tested for everything.

restaurant_name: บางละมุงการแพทย์ คลินิกเวชกรรม
text: Previously, the staff used to speak rudely. Today, the staff seemed to have changed. They spoke kindly and were very attentive. The doctor spoke politely and asked for details to examine my symptoms. I was very impressed.

text: I had a personal experience with the one-month contraceptive injection. The doctor said it was a monthly injection, but it was DMPA, which is a three-month injection of 150mg. The doctor divided it into 50mg injections per month. No other doctor administers this; only this clinic does. It's not effective at contraception. Other doctors said it's used for treating diseases if you inject more than the recommended amount. I went to ask about the Psychofem injection, but they gave me DMPA instead.

restaurant_name: บางละมุงการแพทย์ คลินิกเวชกรรม
text:
On October 9th, 2019, my boyfriend went to get a medical certificate. The officer asked what type of driver's license he was applying for. He replied that he was applying for both. The officer said he needed two certificates, even though all he really needed was to make photocopies for only 2 baht. Because my boyfriend didn't know any better, he paid for two medical certificates.
For anyone going to get a medical certificate for a car or motorcycle driver's license, I recommend getting only one and making photocopies. Don't let the clinic push you to get two like my boyfriend did.
